# AI Visibility Fix Plan

> Prioritize Structure, Authority, and Presence fixes for prompts where AI answers do not cite you.

Turn AI visibility and answer-gap evidence into a concrete remediation plan: identify why the current cited source wins, choose the right build path, and define acceptance checks for improving AI citations, mentions, and third-party presence.

An atomic marketing skill you run inside Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT (custom MCP), Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, or any MCP client — read-only public-data research, **eyes not hands**. It diagnoses, prices, and drafts evidence; your own assistant and accounts take any action.

## What it's good for

- AI visibility teams turning audits into concrete remediation work
- SEO and content teams deciding which AI-answer gaps to fix first
- Founders who need to know whether the fix is page structure, authority, or third-party presence

## What you get

- Prioritized prompt-level fix plan with current owner, miss cause, build path, and acceptance check

- Quick-win flags where the brand ranks organically but is not cited
- Re-check plan for the same prompt set, market, and AI engine

## What it reads

Live public data through the shared [`unifapi`](../../unifapi/) data skill — UnifAPI APIs: **geo, seo, browser**. Connect once over OAuth; no scraping to maintain and no keys to rotate. Every figure in the output is cited to the record it came from.

## Example prompt

```text
Turn these AI visibility gaps into an AI visibility fix plan. For each high-value prompt, classify the miss as Structure, Authority, or Presence, choose the build path, and define the acceptance check.
```

## FAQ

### Why not call this AI Citation Fix Plan?

The work is broader than citations. AI visibility fixes also include answer presence, extractability, authority signals, and third-party surfaces that AI answers already cite.

### Does it create AI-only pages?

No. It improves human pages so they are clearer, better cited, and easier for AI systems to extract. It avoids doorway or AI-only pages.
